tvShow.name: Sofia the First: Royal Magic
tvShow.overview: Follow Sofia as she attends The Charmswell School for Royal Magic, where she discovers she is the most magical princess in the realm and must learn how to master her powers while making new royal friends.

episodes.name: Welcome to Charmswell
episodes.overview: It's Sofia's first day of royal magic school, and she teams up with new friends to win a race and gets a magical visit from Rapunzel.

episodes.name: Abracadazzle
episodes.overview: Sofia joins a magical challenge against students from the other castles.

episodes.name: Show and Spell
episodes.overview: Layla tries a levitation spell but instead reveals her ability to sprout butterfly wings.

episodes.name: Give it a Twirl
episodes.overview: Sofia and Layla co-captain a magical parade, but they can't agree on anything.

episodes.name: The Tippity Tap Dance
episodes.overview: Zane uses magic to improve his dance moves but when the charm becomes a curse, Sofia helps solve it.

episodes.name: Magic Mayhem
episodes.overview: Camila wants to be Cedric's apprentice but causes chaos with advanced spells.

episodes.name: Royal Mix It Up
episodes.overview: Sofia is paired up with Zane's sister Zaria for a tri-castle activity, but they have nothing in common.

episodes.name: A Royal Family Picnic
episodes.overview: While on a family picnic, Amber wants to prove she's just as amazing as Sofia.

episodes.name: The Royal Playdate
episodes.overview: When Layla meets Sofia's siblings, Amber and James, she goes to extreme lengths to impress them.

episodes.name: New Horse on the Block
episodes.overview: Sofia and her new flying horse Wildfyre try out for the Charmswell Flying Derby.

episodes.name: The Green-Eyed Monster
episodes.overview: Wanting to be good at potions, Zane accidentally creates out-of-control Green-Eyed Goo Monsters.

episodes.name: Sleepy Time Spell
episodes.overview: At a sleepover at Sofia's castle with Camilla and Layla, stuffies magically come to life.

episodes.name: Zane the Hero
episodes.overview: A grumpy dragon is on the loose at Charmswell, and Zane tries to tame the bumbling beast.

episodes.name: Veggie Good Deed
episodes.overview: Wanting to do a good deed, Amber helps Sofia with the village feast but causes some magical problems instead.

episodes.name: The Lilygnome
episodes.overview: Sofia needs Layla's help to tame a mischievous magical flower.

episodes.name: Crown Chaos
episodes.overview: Sofia defends Charmswell Academy from the wicked sorceress, Zandrya, with help from Rapunzel.

episodes.name: Of to the Races
episodes.overview: Camila learns to be there for her friends during the school's flying derby race.

episodes.name: When Clover Met Pepper
episodes.overview: Clover meets Pepper when he visits Sofia's castle, and Clover worries Sofia has a new best pet friend.

episodes.name: A Wand-erful Day
episodes.overview: James accidentally breaks Sofia's wand and replaces it with a trick wand.

episodes.name: Kidding Around
episodes.overview: Sofia makes a wish that accidentally turns her mom into a kid.

episodes.name: Puppercorn Ruckus
episodes.overview: Sofia helps Camila during a class project when they are overwhelmed by adorable puppercorns.

episodes.name: The Enchanted Lake
episodes.overview: Zane accidentally loses Layla's treasured notebook in the Charmswell lake.

episodes.name: Tricky Trixie
episodes.overview: Camila lets a friendly troll borrow her wand, and the troll runs away with it.

episodes.name: Hallow's Eve Hijinks
episodes.overview: Zane releases a mischievous goblin to help win a Hallow's Eve decoration contest.

episodes.name: Costume Clash
episodes.overview: Lucinda the Witch and Camila spend All Hallow's Eve with Sofia.

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: Welcome to the Charmswell School for Royal Magic! Spend time with Sofia and her Royal Friends, where she takes you on a sparkling tour of her brand-new royal school, where every castle shines with its own special kind of magic. Along the way, she'll introduce you to her old and new friends — Pepper, Clover, Layla, Zane, and Camila — each with amazing talents and magical gifts of their own. With Sofia as your guide, there's no better way to discover the magic of Charmswell!
